blocks.raw: Access to the Modulr API must be over HTTPS in all environments.
blocks.text: Access to the Modulr API must be over HTTPS in all environments.

blocks.raw: HMAC is used to authenticate API calls. As such, you are required to calculate a signature which must be included in the authorization header when making requests.
blocks.text: HMAC is used to authenticate API calls. As such, you are required to calculate a signature which must be included in the authorization header when making requests.

blocks.raw: The signature will be unique per API request and will include:
blocks.text: The signature will be unique per API request and will include:

blocks.raw:
* Your **API Key** (Sometimes referred to as your **token**)
* Your **API HMAC secret** (Sometimes referred to as your **HMAC** or **Secret**)
blocks.text: Your API Key (Sometimes referred to as your token)Your API HMAC secret (Sometimes referred to as your HMAC or Secret)

blocks.raw: For Production: these will be provided during onboarding.
blocks.text: For Production: these will be provided during onboarding.

blocks.raw: For Sandbox: these will be provided when you create your Sandbox Account.
blocks.text: For Sandbox: these will be provided when you create your Sandbox Account.

blocks.raw: Keys and secrets must be kept secure as they authenticate all requests as being approved by your organisation. Instructions on creating the signature are detailed here: [Authentication](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/authentication).
blocks.text: Keys and secrets must be kept secure as they authenticate all requests as being approved by your organisation. Instructions on creating the signature are detailed here: Authentication.

blocks.raw: Access to the API in the live environment is restricted by IP address. Your IP addresses will be requested during onboarding.
blocks.text: Access to the API in the live environment is restricted by IP address. Your IP addresses will be requested during onboarding.

blocks.raw: Note that sandbox keys may be time limited to 1 month to allow evaluation. Should you require an extension please contact us.
